You got some of them. That's the job. The job is not everybody, it has never been everybody, and anyone who tells you it is has not done it.
 You'll want to give me the names of the ones you didn't. Don't. I already have them. I write them down before I need to.

evidence.speaker: SOL — flat
evidence.quote:
It was my yard, Vasko. My yard, at four in the morning, because of three borehole heads that a month ago were doing their job.
 I am telling you that as a fact, not as a knife. I have to be able to say the true shape of a thing out loud or I stop being able to do this.

evidence.speaker: REN
evidence.quote: Sol would have to run it with you, and you have not stood in front of her since the water came up.

findings.scopeLimit: この会話取得経路だけの説明上の診断。実測した通常プレイの不具合ではない。災害の同一性は推論であり、手動再現と非会話時系列は未検証。

result.interpretation: NR1-01は確定した災害時系列矛盾・進行不具合という強さを落とし、この取得文面で対面条件を区別しにくい点だけを残した。残る3件は人物の動機・自発的説明・優先順位の変更によって反証された。
